mission_text: Associazione Studenti Musulmani (ASM) strives to facilitate a welcoming and active community for Muslim students on campus. We aim to support our members in balancing their academic pursuits with their spiritual growth, while fostering an inclusive environment that promotes understanding and dialogue.

events.agenda:
The Association of Muslim Students (ASM) invites you to a relaxed networking event where you can meet fellow Muslim students, exchange experiences, share ideas, and build new friendships.

Whether you're a new student or have been at Polimi for years, this is a great opportunity to get to know each other, expand your network, and strengthen our community.
events.desc:
🌙 ASM Networking Event – Connect, Meet & Grow!
Looking to meet new people, make new connections, and become part of the Muslim student community at Polimi?
events.title: Networking
events.what_to_bring:
Your positive energy and a friendly smile!
Feel free to bring a friend who would like to join the community!
